  "lemmas": [
    {
      "lemma": "property lemma_1; @(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) (i <= N); endproperty",
      "explanation": "Reset initializes i to zero, and the loop increments it only while i < N. This bound rules out unreachable LOOP states with i beyond N."
    },
    {
      "lemma": "property lemma_2; @(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) (sum == i / 5); endproperty",
      "explanation": "The blocking assignment increments i before testing divisibility by five, so sum counts the multiples of five reached through i."
    },
    {
      "lemma": "property lemma_3; @(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) (state != DONE || i == N); endproperty",
      "explanation": "Given lemma_1, the loop can enter DONE only when i equals N. Lemma_2 then gives sum = N / 5 = n, proving the target property."
    }
  ]
}
</json>

These lemmas form a 1-inductive strengthening for the default parameters, assuming reset establishes the initial state. They require `N` to fit in `i`; if `5*n` exceeds the maximum value of `i`, the counter can wrap and the stated invariant need not hold.
